Package io.milvus.common.utils

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    BloomFilterUtils
    Builds a client-side Split-Block Bloom Filter (SBBF) blob for the bloom_match(field, {blob}) filter expression.
    BloomFilterUtils.Builder
    Incrementally constructs an SBBF and serializes it into an MBF1 envelope.
    ExceptionUtils
    Utility methods for throwing and handling exceptions in the Milvus SDK.
    Float16Utils
    Utility class for converting between float32 and half-precision types (fp16 and bf16).
    JsonUtils
    JSON serialization and deserialization helpers backed by a thread-safe Gson instance.
    RedactCredential
    Utility methods that mask credentials and other sensitive URI information in log messages.
    RoaringBitmapUtils
    Builds a client-side roaring bitmap blob for the roaring_match(field, {blob}) filter expression.
    RoaringBitmapUtils.Builder
    Incrementally collects members and serializes them into an MRB1 blob.
    URLParser
    Parses a Milvus connection URI into its hostname, port, database, and TLS settings.
    VectorUtils
    Utility methods for building query expressions from primary key values.
